Conflict card

Input: method POST, status 429, idempotent false

Rule A - Retry every HTTP 429 response - applies to this input and requires action: retry

Rule B - Never retry a non-idempotent POST - applies to this input and requires action: stop

The required actions retry and stop are incompatible, they cannot both be done.

Which rule wins for this input?
cost_basis: all terminal provider usage, persisted from first request
